Performed an internal review of analytics and reporting tool permissions across the CompanyOS environment to identify current access levels, potential over‑privileged accounts, and gaps in least‑privilege enforcement.
decisions.recommended_direction: Disable or delete admin accounts for former employees and enforce a quarterly account‑review process.
supporting_recommendations: Disable or delete admin accounts for former employees and enforce a quarterly account‑review process.
Restrict power_user SQL execute rights to approved stored procedures; implement role‑based query templating.
Remove nested group inheritance that grants unintended admin privileges in the BI Dashboard Platform.
Disable guest access on internal report folders; move any public‑facing reports to a securely vetted publishing pipeline.
Enforce MFA for all roles with write or export capabilities (author, designer, power_user).
Implement automated alerting for anomalous export or data‑access patterns based on baseline usage.

known_risks.risk: Privilege creep leading to unauthorized data exposure
Insufficient MFA on high‑privilege roles increasing credential‑theft risk
Guest‑enabled folders leaking aggregated sensitive metrics

proposed_internal_actions: Run a script to list all active analytics/tool service accounts and compare against HR termination records.
Update role definitions in each tool to remove excessive privileges and document approved permission matrices.
Enable MFA enforcement policies via the identity provider for the identified high‑risk roles.
Audit guest/shared links in the reporting suite and revoke any that are not explicitly approved.
Schedule a recurring (monthly) permission review meeting with the data governance team.
Configure SIEM correlation rules to flag export actions exceeding baseline thresholds.

decisions.title: Identified potential internal locations for performance score methodology documentation and data access paths, and outlined next steps to retrieve them.
decisions.recommended_direction: Search the internal Knowledge Base using keywords such as "performance score methodology", "scoring algorithm", and "metrics definition".
supporting_recommendations: Search the internal Knowledge Base using keywords such as "performance score methodology", "scoring algorithm", and "metrics definition".
Query the Data Catalog for the "Performance Metrics" dataset and review its lineage, schema, and access permissions.
Contact the Data Governance team to confirm current access rights and any recent changes to the data access paths.
If documentation is not found, request the Analytics Team to provide the latest methodology deck or a written summary.
known_risks: Documentation may be outdated or missing, leading to incomplete understanding of the methodology.
Access to the data may be restricted to certain roles, potentially blocking retrieval of the required paths.
Misinterpretation of legacy documentation could result in incorrect implementation of the performance score.
proposed_internal_actions: Perform a keyword search in the internal Knowledge Base.
Retrieve the dataset definition and lineage from the Data Catalog.
Schedule a brief meeting with the Data Governance team to clarify access permissions.
Document any gaps found and propose a plan to update or create missing documentation.
